extensionName.description: Extension name. Must not include "Chrome" or imply Google endorsement.

extensionDescription.message: Audit the current page for layout, link, form, image, SEO and accessibility issues. Review findings and highlight elements to fix.
extensionDescription.description: Chrome Web Store short description. Maximum 132 characters.

uiOpenSidePanelTitle.message: Keep the dashboard open while you interact with the page

uiConsentIntro.message: Website Page Auditor audits the webpage you're viewing and helps you find and review quality issues. To do that, it has to read the page you choose to check.

uiConsentReads.message: What it reads: the page address and title, visible text, HTML structure, styles and element sizes, links, images, and form field labels and settings. It does not read what you type into form fields, passwords or cookies.

uiConsentWhen.message: When: only on the tab where you open it, and only when you check the page, open the Search appearance tab or use an Inspect page tool.

uiConsentWhere.message: Where findings go: they stay in this browser's temporary storage for that tab and are deleted when the tab closes or moves to another page. Nothing is sent to the developer or to any other server.

uiConsentOptional.message: Optional checks that interact with the page or send requests are off by default. Turn them on in Settings before they run. UI tests briefly open and close tabs. Form tests use sample values but block submissions. Search sends a real query and may navigate. Same-site links use your session; external link checks require site access.

uiNotAudited.message: This page hasn't been audited yet.

uiEmptyExplanation.message: Press “Check this page”, or run a single category above. Findings are grouped as Issue found, Possible issue, Review manually and No issue found. Click a finding to highlight its element on the page. Automated checks find common problems; they don't replace human review.

uiImagesHint.message: Natural = source pixels; rendered = on-screen size. Cropping hides parts; distortion changes proportions. Resizing is normal.

uiImagesEmpty.message: Run the Images category on the Page audit tab to list the images on this page.

uiSeoHint.message: covers basic SEO (search engine optimization) signals: the page title, headings, image alt text, links, the Google tag and the image used in link previews.

uiFilterSearchByStatus.message: Filter search appearance checks by status

uiSeoEmpty.message: Search appearance checks run automatically every time this tab is opened.

uiInspectHint.message: Outline tools add a temporary outline to matching elements so you can review them on the page. Nothing is saved, and “Remove all outlines” restores the page.

uiOptionsDefault.message: These optional checks are off by default. Turn on only the checks you want to run.

uiCheckTabsFocusHelp.message: Temporarily opens tabs and disclosure widgets, then checks visible keyboard focus.

uiCheckFormsHelp.message: Tries sample values in up to five forms. Actual submissions are blocked and fields are restored.

uiTestSearchHelp.message: Sends a real search request and may navigate to results.

uiCheckSameSiteLinksHelp.message: Uses your current site session. Logout, delete, cart, and download links are skipped.

uiCheckExternalLinksHelp.message: Sends cookie-free requests after you allow access to sites.

uiResponsiveHelp.message: Uses Chrome’s required debugger permission to emulate this tab while checks run. Chrome asks for this permission at install time; it attaches only while the feature runs. A brief notice may appear.

uiPrivacySummary.message: Audits read only the page you check. Findings stay in this browser's temporary storage for that tab and are never sent to the developer or any other server.

uiWithdrawConsent.message: Withdraw consent and delete all reports

uiCannotAccessPage.message: The extension cannot access this page.

uiBackgroundUnreachable.message: Could not reach the extension background.

uiAuditStoppedEarly.message: The audit was stopped early; findings are partial.

uiReportOtherPage.message: This report was created for $URL$. The tab now shows a different page, so highlighting may not find elements.

uiNoFilterResults.message: No results match the current filters.

uiViewportRestored.message: . The page has been restored to its normal size, so the highlighted element may look different now.

uiRepeatedExplanation.message: Found on $COUNT$ elements with the same structure. Fixing the shared component or style usually fixes all of them.

uiSkippedCategoryError.message: Skipped (the category stopped with an error): $ERROR$

uiRepeatedStructure.message: $COUNT$ elements with the same structure (for example one component used many times). Listed once.

uiH3CountNote.message: Number of <h3> elements on the page.

uiWordCountNote.message: Visible words in <$SCOPE$>; hidden, script and style text excluded.

uiInternalLinksNote.message: Links with the same origin as this page.

uiExternalLinksNote.message: Links to another origin, including mailto: and tel: (same rule as the “External links” outline on the Inspect page tab).

uiSeoCouldNotRun.message: Could not run the search appearance checks.

uiHighlightedPartial.message: $FOUND$ of $TOTAL$ elements found on the page

uiCouldNotOpenPanel.message: Could not open the side panel: $ERROR$

uiExternalPermissionNeeded.message: External link checks need access to all sites; permission was not granted.

uiExternalDenied.message: External link access was not granted.

uiNothingRead.message: Nothing was read from the page. You can agree at any time to start an audit.

uiConsentWithdrawn.message: Consent withdrawn. All reports were deleted.

uiScanInterrupted.message: The previous scan was interrupted (service worker restarted). Run it again.

uiRestrictedScan.message: Browser and extension pages cannot be scanned.

uiScanAlreadyRunning.message: A scan is already running on this tab.

uiNoSeoData.message: The page returned no SEO data.

uiConsentRequired.message: Agree to the data notice in the extension before auditing a page.

uiRestrictedAudit.message: This is a browser, extension or Web Store page. Browsers never allow extensions to audit these pages.

uiCannotAccessHelp.message: The extension cannot access this page. Click the extension icon on this tab (allows temporary access) or allow access to this site in Settings. Browser pages, the Web Store and other extensions' pages can never be audited.

uiTabClosed.message: The tab was closed or navigated during the operation.

uiEmulationUnavailableDetail.message: Screen-size emulation was unavailable ($ERROR$). The browser window was not resized.

uiEmulationUnavailableSkip.message: Screen-size emulation is unavailable; browser window was not resized.

uiDebuggerDetached.message: Viewport emulation stopped: the debugger was detached ($REASON$).

uiViewportNotRestored.message: The original viewport ($SIZE$) could not be confirmed after testing.

uiViewportNotRestoredNow.message: The original viewport ($SIZE$) could not be confirmed after testing (now $NOW$).

uiRestrictedPageInspect.message: This is a browser or extension page; browsers do not allow extensions to inspect it.

uiExternalNoAccess.message: External link checks are enabled but host access was not granted, so $COUNT$ external link(s) were not requested. Turn “Check external links” off and on again in Settings to allow access.

uiOpenLinkManually.message: Open the link manually; some servers block automated requests.

uiExternalBlocked.message: External server answered HTTP $STATUS$ — it may block automated checks; verify manually.

uiExternalSummary.message: $OK$ of $TOTAL$ requested external URL(s) answered with HTTP 2xx/3xx (HEAD, no cookies)$EXTRA$. A successful response does not prove the page shows the expected content.

uiSkippedDestructive.message: $COUNT$ skipped as possibly destructive (logout, delete, cart…)
